m: ता f. Lakṣmī, L.

a: तांबूली — The betel-plant; तांबूलीनां दलैस्तत्र रचितापानभूमयः R. 4. 42.

तांबूलं — 1 The areca-nut. --2 The leaf of piper-betel, which together with the areca-nut, catechu, chunam, and spices is usually chewed after meals; तांबूलभृतगल्लोऽयं भल्लं जल्पति मानुषः K. P. 7; रागो न स्खलितस्तवाधरपुटे तांबूलसंवर्धितः Ś. Til. 7. --Comp. --अधिकारः the office of carrying the betel-box; Pt. 1. --करंकः, --पेटिका a betel-box; (Mar. पानदान, पानपुडा). --दः, --धरः, --वाहकः a servant attached to men of rank to carry the betel-box and to provide them with तांबूल whenever necessary. --वल्ली the betel-plant; R. 6. 64.
तांबूलिकः — A seller of betel.
तांबूलिन् — a. Relating to betel. --m. A servant who prepares the Tāmbūla and gives it to his master when wanted.

तांडवः --वं — 1 Dancing in general; मदतांडवोत्सवांते U. 3. 18; भ्रू˚ dance or playful movement of the eyebrows; 3. 19. --2 Particularly, the frantic or violent dance of Śiva; त्र्यंबकानंदि वस्तांडवं देवि भूयादभीष्ट्यै च हृष्ट्यै च नः Māl. 5. 23, 1. 1. --3 The art of dancing. --4 A sort of grass. --5 (In prosody) A foot of three short syllables. --Comp. --तालिकः an epithet of Nandin, the doorkeeper of Śiva. --प्रियः N. of Śiva.
तांडवित — a. 1 Dancing, made to dance; Māl. 2. --2 Moving round in a wild dance; U. 5. 36. --3 Fluttering. --4 Frowning.
तांडिः — The science of dancing.
तांत — p. p. [तम्-क्त] 1 Wearied, languid, fatigued. --2 Troubled, afflicted. --3 Faded, withered; see तम्.
तांत — See under तम्.
तांतव — a. (वी f.) [तंतोर्विकारः अञ्] 1 Made of threads. --वं {1} Spinning, weaving. --2 A web. --3 A woven cloth.
तांत्रिक — a. (की f.) 1 Well-versed in any science or doctrine. --2 Relating to the Tantras. --3 Taught or contained in them. --कः A follower of Tantra doctrines.
तांतुवायिः, तांतवाय्यः — The son of a weaver.

a: तालः — [तल् एव अण्] 1 The palmyra tree; Bh. 2. 90; R. 15. 23. --2 A banner formed of the palm. --3 Slapping or clapping the hands together, the noise made by it; Māl. 5. 23. --4 Flapping in general. --5 Flapping of the ears of an elephant. --6 Beating time (in music); करकिसलयतालैर्मुग्धया नर्त्यमानं U. 3. 10; Me. 79. --7 A musical instrument made of bell-metal; R. 9. 71. --8 The palm of the hand. --9 A lock, bolt. --10 The hilt of a sword. --11 An epithet of Śiva. --12 (In prosody) A trochee. --13 A particular measure of height. --14 A short span. --लं 1 The nut of the palmyra tree. --2 Yellow orpiment. --Comp. --अंकः {1} N. of Balarāma. {2} the palm-leaf used for writing. {3} a book. {4} a saw. {5} N. of Śiva. {6} a man endowed with every fortunate mark or sign. --अवचरः a dancer, an actor. --केतुः an epithet of Bhīṣma. --क्षीरकं, --गर्भः the exudation of the palm. --जटा, --प्रलंबः the fibres of the palm tree. --ध्वजः, --भृत् m. an epithet of Balarāma. --पत्रं {1} the palm-leaf used for writing. {2} a kind of ear-ornament (hollow cylinder of gold thrust through the lobe of the ear). --बद्ध, --शुद्ध a. measured, rhythmical, regulated by musical time. --मर्दलः a kind of musical instrument, a cymbal. --यंत्रं {1} a kind of surgical instrument. {2} a lock, a lock and key. --रेचनकः a dancer, an actor. --लक्षणः an epithet of Balarāma. --वनं a grove of trees. --वृंतं a fan; Ś. 3. 21, Ku. 2. 35; also तालवृंतकः.

BAdraSuklanavamI । yaTA, “mAsi BAdrapade yA syAnnavamI bahuletarA । tasyAM saMpUjya vE durgAmaSvameDaPalaM laBet ॥” iti saMvatsarakOmudIDftagaruqapurARavacanam ॥ iyameva tAlanavamI KyAtA ॥ (asyAM navamyAM sOBAgyaPalakANkziRIBiH strIBiryaTAviDAnaM nArAyaRaM lakzmIYca saMpUjya vratakaTA SrotavyA । tatkaTA yaTA, -- “merupfzWe suKAsInaM kfzRaM kamalayA saha । uvAca maDuraM vAkyaM smitapUrvvaM mudAmbikA ॥ SfRu me vacanaM deva ! strIRAM sOBAgyakAraRam । kena vA suBagA cAsIt kena vA durBagA Bavet ॥ kiM kftena vimucyeta kiM kftena PalaM laBet । tanme brUhi suraSrezWa ! nArIRAM kAraRaM Dravam ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । pUrvvaM hi mama BAryye dve satyaBAmA ca rukmiRI । rukmiRI suBagA sADvI satyaBAmA ca durBagA ॥ tasyAH karmmavipAkena sOBAgyamanyaTA gatam । kenacidbAkyadozeRa satyaBAmA ca durBagA ॥ duHKArttA SokasantaptA rudatI bahuSo muhuH । kiyatkAle ca sampanne vrajantI ca tapovane ॥ araRye vijane gatvA kasminmunivarASrame । ruditvA ca viDAnena sarvvaM duHKaM nyavedayat ॥ tacCratvA tu muniSrezWaH provAca rudatIM SuBAm । Bavye puttriRi ! mA rodIH sOBAgyaM te Bavizyati ॥ satyaBAmovAca । duHKaM me bahuSastAta ! SarIraM durBagaM kaTam । kaTyatAM muniSArddUla ! svAmisOBAgyakAraRam ॥ muniruvAca । BAdre mAsi site pakze navamI yA tITirBavet । tasyAM nArAyaRaM lakzmIM pUjayecca viDAnataH ॥ satyaBAmovAca । viDAnaM kIdfSaM tasya kiM dAnaM kiYca pUjanam । tanme brUhi muniSrezWa ! kAraRaM kintaducyatAm ॥ muniruvAca । sTaRqile maRqalaM kftvA GawaM tatra niveSayet । tatra nArAyaRaM lakzmIM ganDapuzpAdinArccayet ॥ nEvedyena sadA BaktyA pUjayet BaktavatsalAm । tAlena pUjayet devIM tAlenEva vinirmmitam ॥ tasye tat pizwakaM dattvA brAhmaRAyopapAdayet । ganDamAlyEH samaByarccya viprahaste samarpitam ॥ svastIti brAhmaRo brUyAt vrataM sANgaM samAcaret । evaM krameRa sADvIBiH karttavyamatiyatnataH ॥ navamaM vatsaraM yAvat mAsi BAdrapade taTA । puttrapOttrEH parivftA sOBAgyamatulaM Bavet ॥ DanaDAnyasamfdDiYca avEDavyaYca nityaSaH । aBIzwaPalamApnoti navamIvratakAraRAt ॥ sampUrRe tu vrate BUte pratizWAM tadanantaram । viprAya dakziRA deyA suBojyaYca viDAnataH ॥ evaM kuru sadA vijYe ! SfRu BAzaRamuttamam ॥ taTA cakre ca sA sADvI munervvacanagOravAt । vrate sampUrRatAM yAte keSavastAmupAgataH ॥ uvAca prahasan devo vacanaM maDuraM SuBam । asOBAgyena yadduHKaM tat te sarvvaM vinaSyatu ॥ sOBAgyamatulaM prApya yaTA gOrI harasya ca । SacIva puruhUtasya ratIva madanasya ca ॥ yaTA nArAyaRe lakzmIstaTA tvaM Bava SoBane ! । iti tasyE varaM dattvA gfhItvA tAM puraM yayO ॥ idaM yA kurute sADvI vrataM sA suBagA Bavet । evaM vrataYca yA nArI karoti DarmmatatparA ॥ tasyASca Bavane lakzmIScaYcalA niScalA Bavet । janmAntare Bavet sADvI avEDavyaM sadA punaH ॥ patyuSca suBagA sADvI puttrapOttrAnnitA Bavet । DanaDAnyasamfdDiYca tato mokzamavApnuyAt ॥” iti BavizyapurARoktatAlanavamIvratakaTA samAptA ॥ * ॥ vrate'smin navaPalAni dAtavyAni । tAni yaTA, -- “piRqaKarjjUraM jAtiSca elA cEva harItakI । nArikelaM taTA pUgaM ramBApakvaPalantaTA । tatra muKyaM pradAtavyaM tAlasya Palamuttamam ॥” * ॥)

Uṇ. 1. 5] The palate; तृषा महत्या परिशुष्कतालवः Rs. 1. 11. --Comp. --जिह्वः {1} a crocodile. {2} the uvula. --पाकः an abscess in the palate. --पुप्पुटः an indolent swelling of the palate. --मूलं the root or back-part of the palate. --स्थान a. palatal. --(नं) the palate.

s: tri, (tama eva । tamas + svArTe aR .) prakftiguRaviSezaH । tadDarmmA yaTA, -- “triviDA Bavati SradDA dehinAM sA svaBAvajA । sAttvikI rAjasI cEva tAmasI ceti tAM SfRu ॥ yajante sAttvikA devAn yakzarakzAMsi rAjasAH । pretAn BUtagaRAMScAnye yajante tAmasA janAH ॥ yAtayAmaM gatarasaM pUtiparyyuzitaYca yat । ucCizwamapi cAmeDyaM BojanaM tAmasapriyam ॥ viDihInamasfzwAnnaM mantrahInamadakziRam । SradDAvirahitaM yajYaM tAmasaM paricakzate ॥ mUQagrAheRAtmano yat pIqayA kriyate tapaH । parasyotsAdanArTaM vA tattAmasamudAhftam ॥ adeSakAle yaddAnamapAtreByaSca dIyate । asatkftamavajYAnaM tattAmasamudAhftam ॥” iti SrIBagavadgItAyAM 17 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ kiYca tatrEva 18 aDyAye । “niyatasya tu sannyAsaH karmmaRo nopapadyate । mohAttasya parityAgastAmasaH parikIrttitaH ॥ yattu kftsnavadekasmin kAryye saktamahetukam । atattvArTavadalpaYca tattAmasamudAhftam ॥ anubanDaM kzayaM hiMsAmanapekzya ca pOruzam । mohAdAraByate karmma yattattAmasamucyate ॥ ayuktaH prAkftastabDaH Sawo nEkftiko'lasaH । vizAdI dIrGasUtrI ca karttA tAmasa ucyate ॥ aDarmmaM Darmmamiti yA manyate tamasAvftA । sarvvArTAn viparItAMSca budDiH sA pArTa ! tAmasI । yayA svapnaM BayaM SokaM vizAdaM madameva ca । na vimuYcati durmmeDA DftiH sA tAmasI matA ॥ yadagre cAnubanDe ca suKamohanamAtmanaH । nidrAlasyapramAdotTaM tattAmasamudAhftam ॥”

puM, (tamastamoguRaH praGAnatvenAstyasyeti । aR .) sarpaH । KalaH । iti medinI । se, 25 ॥ ulUkaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ caturTamanuH । asminmanvantare harinAmA vizRoravatAraH । triSiKanAmA indraH । vEDftayo devAH । jyotirGAmAdayaH saptarzayaH । vfzaKyAtinarAdayo manusutAH । iti SrIBAgavatam ॥ * ॥ tamoguRayukte, tri ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 12 । 33 । “loBaH svapno'DftiH krOryyaM nAstikyaM BinnavfttitA । yAcizRutA pramAdaSca tAmasaM guRalakzaRam ॥”) tAmasamunayo yaTA । kaRAdaH 1 gOtamaH 2 SaktriH 3 upamanyuH 4 jEminiH 5 durvvAsAH 6 mfkaRquH 7 bfhaspatiH 8 BArgavaH 9 jamadagniH 10 ॥ tAmasaSAstrARi yaTA । asuramohanArTaSivakftaSEvapASupatAdi 1 kaRAdakftanagnanIlapawAdi 2 brAhmaRarUpiBagavadkftabOdDaSAstram 3 jEminikftanirISvarasAMKyam 4 ॥ tAmasapurARAni yaTA । mAtsyam 1 kOrmmam 2 lENgam 3 SEvam 4 skAndam 5 Agneyam 6 ॥ tAmasasmftayo yaTA । gOtamam 1 bArhaspatyam 2 sAmudram 3 yamam 4 SANKyam 5 OSanasam 6 ॥ * ॥ rAjasatAmasakarmmARi yaTA, -- “yat SEvaM dEvataM pEtramOpadEvaM taTADvaram । SAktaM SEvaM gARapatyaM yAgahomAdikaM taTA ॥ pOrohityaM yAjanaYca devalkaM grAmayAjakam । vizRusevAparADaYca taTA nAmAparADakam ॥ asatpratigrahaM devi ! sANkalpamABicArikam । paSujIvAdihananaM pAtakaYcopapAtakam ॥ atipApaM mahApApamanupAtakameva ca । loBaM mohamahaNkAraM kAmaM kroDaM madantaTA ॥ etadyadaparaM karmma garhitaYca varAnane ! । rAjasaM tAmasaM proktaM mayA ca muniBiH sadA ॥” iti pAdmottaraKaRqam ॥
v: tri॰ tamo'styasya tamaH, praDAnatvenAstyasya vA aR । 1 tamoguRayukte 2 tamaHpraDAnaguRake striyAM NIp । 3 sarpe puMstrI॰ jAtitvAt NIz । 4 Kale tri॰ medi॰ 5 ulUke puMstrI rAjani॰ striyAM NIz । 6 caturTe manO pu॰ “satyA devagaRAScEva tAmasasyAntare manoH । putrAMScEva pravakzyAmi tAmasasya manornfpa! । dyutistapasyaH sutapAstapomUlastapo'SanaH । taporatirakalmAzastanvI DanvI parantapaH । tAmasasya manorete daSa putrA mahAbalAH” harivaM॰ 7 a॰ । “caturTe uttamaBrAtA manurnAmnA ca tAmasaH । pfTuH BAtirnavaH keturityAdyA daSa tatsutAH । satyakA harayo GIrA devAstriSiKaISvaraH । jyotirDAmAdayaH sapta fzayastAmase'ntare । devA vEDftayo nAma viDftestanayA nfpa! । nazwAH kAlena yErvedA viDftAH svena tejasA । BAga॰ 8 । 1 । 24 । BAgavate anyaToktaM kalpaBedAdavirudDam । tamo'Dikftya pravfttam aR tamasA kftA vA aR । 7 tamoguRADikAreRa pravftte SAstre 8 tamasAkfte ca striyAM NIp । tAmasaSAstrARi ca padmapurARe pArvatIM pratISvaravAkyenoktAni yaTA “SfRu devi! pravakzyAmi tAmasAni yaTAkramam । yezAM SravaRamAtreRa pAtityaM jYAninAmapi । praTamaM hi mayEvoktaM SEvaM pASupatABiDam । macCaktyAveSitErviprEH saMproktAni tataHparam । kaRAdena tu samproktaM SAstraM vESezikaM mahat । gOtamena taTA nyAyaM sANKyantu kapilena vE । dvijanmanA jEmininA pUrvaM vedamapArTataH । nirISvareRa vAdena kftaM SAstra mahattaram । DizaRena ca saMproktaM cArvAkamatigarhitam । dEtyAnAM nASanArTAya vizRunA budDarUpiRA । bOdDaSAstramasat proktaM nagnanIlapawAdikam । mAyAvAdamasacCAstraM pracCannaM vOdDameva ca । mayEva kaTitaM devi! kalO brAhmaRarUpiRA । apArTaM SrutivAkyAnAM darSayallokagarhitam । karmasvarUpatyAjyatvamatra ca pratipAdyate । sarvakarmapariBraMSAnnEzkrarmyaM tatra cocyate । parAtmajIvayorEkyaM mayAtra pratipAdyate । brahmaRo'sya paraM rUpaM nirguRaM darSitaM mayA । sarvasya jagato'pyasya nASanArTaM kalO yuge । vedArTavanmahASAstraM mAyAvAdamavEdikam । mayEva kaTitaM devi! jagatAM nASakAraRAt” kUrmapurARe kezAYcittantrARAM tAmasatvamuktaM yaTA “yAni SAstrARi dfSyante loke'smin viviDAni ca । SrutismftivirudDAni nizWA tezAM tu tAmasI । karAlaBEravaYcApi yAmalaM vAmamASritam । evaMviDAni cAnyAni mohanArTAni tAni tu । mayA sfzwAni cAnyAni mohAyEzAM BavArRave” । tAmasa puraRAni yaTA । “mAtsyaM kOrmmaM taTA lENgaM SEvaM skAndaM taTEva ca । AgneyaYca zaqetAni tAmasAni nivoGata” । sAttvika purARAni yaTA । “vEzRavaM nAradIyaYca taTA BAgavataM SuBam । gAruqaYca taTA pAdmaM vArAha SuBadarSane! । sAttvikAni purARAni vijYeyAni SuBAni vE” । rAjasa purARAni yaTA “vrahmARqaM vrahmavEvarttaM mArkaRqeyaM taTEva ca । BavizyaM vAmanaM brAhmaM rAjasAni SuBAnane!” padma॰ u॰ Ka॰ 43 a॰ । “saNkIrRezu sarasvatyAH pitfRAM vyazwirucyate । agneH Sivasya mAhAtmyaM tAmasezu divAkare । rAjasezu ca mAhAtmyamaDikaM brahmaRaH smftam । yasmin kalpe tu yat proktaM purARaM brahmaRA purA । tasya tasya tu mAhAtmyaM tatsvarUpeRa varRyate । sAttvikezvaDikaM tadvadvizRormAhAtmyamuttamam । taTEva yogasaMsidDA gamizyanti parAM gatim” matsya pu॰ । tAmasamunayaH padmapu॰ u॰ uktA yaTA । “kaRAdo gOtamaH SaktirupamanyuSca jEminiH । durvAsASca mfkaRquSca BArgavaSca vfhaspatiH । jamadagniSca ityete munayastAmasAH smftAH” । tAmasasmftayastatrEvoktA yaTA “vArhaspatyA gotamI ca sAMvarttI yamanirmmitA । SANKI cOSanasI cEva tAmasyaH smftayaH smftAH” । tAmasaSradDAdikaM gItAyAM 17 a॰ uktaM yaTA । triviDA Bavati SradDA dehinAM sA svaBAvajA । sAttvi kIrAjasI cEva tAmasI ceti tAM SfRu । yajante sAtvikA devAn yakzarakzAMsi rAjasAH । pretAn BUtAgaRAMScAnye yajante tAmasA janAH” । tAmasAhArAdikamapi BA॰ 17 a॰ uktaM yaTA “yAtayAmaM gatarasaM pUti paryyuzitaYca yat । ucCizwamapi cAmeDyaM BojanaM tAmasapriyam” “viDihInamasfzwAnnaM mantrahInamadakziRam । SradDAvirahitaM yajYaM tAmasaM paricakzate” । “mUQagrAheRAtmano yat pIqayA kriyate tapaH । parasyot sAdanArTaM vA tattAmasamudAhftam” । “adeSakAle yaddAna mapAtreByaSca dIyate । asatkftamavajYAnaM tattAmasamudAhftam” । kiYca “niyatasya tu saMnyAsaH karmmaRo nopapadyate । mIhAttasya parityAgastAmasaH parikIrttitaH” । “yattu kftsnavadekasmin kAryye saktamahetukam । atattvArTavatlpaYca tattAmasamudAhftam । anubanDaM kzayaM hiMsA manapekzya ca pOruzam । mohAdAraByate karma yattattAmasamucyate” । “ayuktaH prAkftastabDaH SaWo nEkftiko'lasaH । vizAdI dIrGasUtrI ca karttA tAmasa ucyate । aDarmaM Darmamiti yA manyate tamasAvftA । sarvArTAn viparItAMSca budDiH sA pArTa! tAmasI” । “yaTA svapnaM BayaM SokaM vizAdaM madameva ca । na vimuYcati durmBeDA DftiH sA tAmasI matA” । “yadagre cAnubanDe ca suKaM mohanamAtmanaH । nidrAlasyapramAdItTaM tattAmasamudAhftam” 18 a॰ । rAjasatAmasakarmmARi yaTA “yat SEvaM dEvataM pEtraM vOpadevaM taTADvaram । SAktaM SEvaM gARapatyaM yAgahomAdikaM taTA । pOrahityaM yAjanaYca dEvalyaM grAmayAjanam । vizRusevAparADaSca taTA nAmAparADakaH । asatpratigraho devi! saNkalpa ABicArikaH । paSujIvAdihananaM pAtakaYcopapAtakam । atipApaM mahApApamanupAtakameva ca । loBo moho hyahaNkAraH kAmaH kroDaH madastaTA । etad yadaparaM karma garhitaYca varAnane! । rAjasaM tAmasaM proktaM mayA ca muniBiH sadA” padma॰ u॰ Ka॰ । hArItaH “tAmasena tu dravyeRa ftvigBistAmasEstaTA । tAmasaM BAvamAsTAya tAmaso yajYa ucyata । tAmasena tu yajYena dAnena tapasA taTA । niraye janma cedAhurvfdDiM vidyAcca tAmasIm” । “tAmasI vfdDimlecCADipatya rUpA” iti ratnAkaraH । tamaso rAhorapatyam aR । 9 rAhusute tAmasakIlaH ।

a: तारा — 1 A star or planet in general; हंसश्रेणीसु तारासु R. 4. 19; Bh. 1. 15. --2 A fixed star; R. 6. 22. --3 The pupil of the eye, the eye-ball; कांतामंतः प्रमोदादभिसरति मदभ्रांततारश्चकोरः Māl. 9. 30; विस्मयस्मेरतारैः 1. 28, Ku. 3, 47. --4 A pearl. --5 (a) N. of the wife of Vāli, king of the monkeys, and mother of Aṅgada. She in vain tried to dissuade her husband Vāli from fighting with Rāma and Sugrīva, and married Sugrīva after Vāli had been killed by Rāma. (b) N. of the wife of Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods. She was on one occasion carried off by Soma (the moon) who refused to deliver her up to her husband when demanded. A fierce contest then ensued, and Brahmā had at last to compel Soma to restore her to her husband. Tārā gave birth to a son named Budha who became the ancestor of the Lunar race of kings. (c) N. of the wife of Hariścandra and mother of Rohidāsa; (also called Tārāmatī). --Comp. --अधिपः {1} the moon; Ku. 7. 48; Bh. 1. 71. {2} Śiva. {3} Bṛhaspati. {4} Vāli. {5} Sugrīva. --आपीडः the moon. --आभः quicksilver. --पतिः {1} the moon; R. 13. 76. {2} Vāli. {3} Bṛhaspati. {4} Śiva. --पथः the atmosphere, firmament. --प्रमाणं sidereal measure, sidereal time. --भूषा the night. --मंडलं {1} the starry region, the zodiac. {2} the pupil of the eye. --मृगः the constellation मृगशिरस्. --मैत्रकं ‘the friendship of the stars’, spontaneous or unaccountable love; Māl. 7, Māl. 4; U. 5. --वर्षं falling stars.

s: strI, candraSeKararAjapatnI । sA ca kakutsTarAjena tatpatnyAM manonmaTinyAM jAtA । asO girijAMSajA । yaTA, -- “ikzvAkuvaMSajo rAjAkakutsTo nAma DArmmikaH । BogavatyAhvayAyAntu puryyAM ripunisUdanaH ॥ sarvvalakzaRasampanno BUpAlaguRasaMyutaH । tasya BAryyA mahABAgA Bargadevasya puttrikA ॥ sA manonmaTinI nAmnA pUjitA pativallaBA । tasyAH puttraSataM jajYe devagarBABamacyutam ॥ balavIryyasamAyuktaM kakutsTanfpasattamAt । puttrI na vidyate tasyAstadarTaM sA gfhAntare ॥ niBftaM sTaRqilaM kftvA caRqikAM samapUjayat । pUjyamAnA mahAdevI caRqikA rAjaBAryyayA ॥ prasannA sA triBirvvarzEstAM svapne cAbravIdidam । yozillakzaRasaMyuktA sArvvaBOmasya BAvinI ॥ nakzatramAlayA yuktA puttrI tava Bavizyati । sApi svapne varaM prApya muditABUnnfpANganA ॥ pArvvatyapi svayaM tasyA garBe kAle viveSa ha । sA manonmaTinI devI pravftte ftusaNgame ॥ garBaM daDO mahAsattvaM candrikevAmftotkaram । sampUrRe tu tataH prApte tadA nakzatramAlinIm ॥ sA manonmaTinI devI suzuve tanayAM SuBAm । tAM dfzwvA hArasaMyuktAM SarajjyotsnopamAM SuBAm ॥ kakutsTo BAryyayA sArdDamatyantamuditI'Bavat । sahajenATa hAreRa BUzitA sA kakutsTajA ॥ vavfDe mandire tasya varzAsviva surApagA । tenEva hAracihnena tasyAstArAvatIti vE ॥ nAmAkarot pitA kAle yaTokte nfpasattamaH । kAlakrameRa sA bAlyaM vyatItya varavarRinI ॥ maYjulaM yOvanodBedaM prApa SrIriva mADave । tasyAstu yOvanodBedaM dfzwvA rAjA sutEH saha ॥ kakutsTaH kArayAmAsa samaye'Ta svayaMvaram । mAGave mAsi saMprApte candravfdDO SuBe dine ॥ svayaMvarasaBAM cakre tArAvatyAH pitA sutEH । vArttikAn subahUn rAjA vaqavABiH krameRa vE ॥ tUrRaM prasTApayAmAsa nAnAdeSanfpAn prati । te rAjAnastaTA SrutvA vArttAM vE vArttikAnanAt ॥ tUrRameva samAjagmustArAvatyAH svayaMvaram । tat SrutvA pOzyatanayaScaturaNgabalEryataH ॥ svayaMvaraM jagAmASu devAlaNkAramaRqitaH । etasminnantare rAjYaH kumArI varavarRinI ॥ vfdDAM DAtrIM nijAM samyak sampUrRajYAnaSAlinIm । svayaMvarasaBAM drazwuM prAhiRot sadasaM prati ॥ svayaMvarasaBAM gatvA cArurUpaM sulakzaRam । nfpaM nirUpya Bo DAtri ! mahyametya nivedaya ॥ evaM tAM prezayitvATa DAtrIM nfpatiputtrikA । sA manonmaTinI yatra prArADayati caRqikAm ॥ tatra prAyAnmahABAgA SuBA tArAvatI tadA । tatra gatvA mahAdevIM praRamya kAlikAhvayAm ॥ mAnuzeRATa BAvena na jYAtvAtmAnamAtmanA । praRanAma mahABaktyA vAkyaYcEtaduvAca ha ॥ praRamAmi mahAmAyAM yoganidrAM jagammayIm । sA me prasIdatAM gOrI caRqikA BaktavatsalA । yadi satyaM jananyA me madarTe tvaM prapUjitA । tena satyena suBagaH patirmmama nfpottamaH ॥ svayaMvare'dya Bavatu prasIda haravallaBe ! । iti tasyA vacaH SrutvA caRqikA haramohinI ॥ mohayantI nfpasutAM yaTAtmAnaM na vetti ca । aTa prAhAdfSyamUrttiridaM sA sUnftaM vacaH ॥ SrIdevyuvAca । pOzyasya tanayo yo'sO nAmnA tu candraSeKaraH । sa manohararUpaste priyaH svAmI BavizyatiM ॥ tamindUkalayA SIrze cihnitaM nfpasattamam । varayasva ravArohe pArvvatIva vfzaDvajam ॥ aTAjagAma sA DAtrI nirUpya sadfSaM patim । tArAvatyAstadAcazwa rahasyaM nfpasattamam ॥ dfzwvA tAmAgatAM DAtrIM prahfzwA nfpateH sutA । papracCa niBftaM kIdfk ko vA dfzwastvayA nfpaH ॥ sA prAha DAtrI vacanAttava BUpA vilokitAH । cArurUpAH kulInASca SAstre Sastre ca pAragAH ॥” “nfpO punarmmahAsattvO siMhaskanDO bfhadBujO । sarvvalakzaRasampannO devAlaNkAramaRqitO ॥ tayorapi vayaHsTatvAt praSastaScandraSeKaraH । sa eva te patiryogyaScihnenAnena sundari ! ॥ taM tvaM varaya rAjAnaM tava yogyaM SuBodayam । DAtryAScEvaM vacaH SrutvA rAjaputtrI jagAda tAm ॥ matpArSvacAriRI BUtvA nideSaya nfpottamam । sAvatIryya tadA yApyayAnAttArAvatI tadA ॥ DAtryA cAnugayA yuktA vyacarat sadaso'ntare । saBAmaDye ciraM sA tu vihftya varavarRinI ॥ BAvitvAnniyateryogAccaRqikAyAH prasAdataH । tayoH samatvAdekatvAttayA DAtryA viboDitA ॥ iti KedajaGarmmAmBaHkaRikAnicitAnanA । patiM pUrvvataraM puttrI rAjYAntArAvatI satI ॥ svayaM sA pArvvatI devI vavre ca candraSeKaram । vEvAhikena viDinA sa rAjA candraSeKaraH ॥ tArAvatIM tadA BAryyAM kakutsTanfpateH sutAm । saMskftya jYApayAmAsa deveByo vEdikErmaKEH ॥ pARigrahaRasaMskAraM kftvA tAM sahacAriRIm । karavIrapurAyASu prayayO candraSeKaraH ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 48 aDyAyaH ॥

a: तारकः — N. of a demon killed by Kārtikeya. [He was the son of Vajrānga and Varāṅgī. He propitiated the god Brahmadeva by means of his penance on the Pāriyātra mountain, and asked as a boon that he should not be killed by any one except a child seven days old. On the strength of this boon he began to oppress the gods who were obliged to go to Brahmā and ask his assistance in the destruction of the demon; (see Ku. 2). But they were told that the offspring of Śiva could alone vanquish him. Afterwards Kārtikeya was born, and he slew the demon on the seventh day of his birth]. --Comp. --अरिः, --जित् m. an epithet of Kārtikeya. (For other senses, see under तॄ).

v: avya॰ tad + bA॰ qAvat । 1 sAkalye 2 avaDO 3 mAne 4 avaDAraRe amaraH 5 praSaMsAyAm 6 pakzAntare SabdaratnA॰ 7 saMgrAme 8 aDikAre ca medi॰ । 9 tadetyarTe SabdArTaci॰ । “BarttApi tAvat kraTakOSikAnAm” raGuH tAvat tadetyarTaH । sAkalye “tAvatprakIrRABinavopacAram” avaDO “valguM na samBAvita eva tAvat” raGuH “tAvat AlokamArgaprAptiparyyantam” malli॰ । mAnArTe “tvameva tAvat paricintaya svayam” kumA॰ tAvat iti mAnArTe “yAvanmAtraM vicAraRIyaM tAvanmAtramityarTaH” malli॰ । avaDAraRe “indraprasTagamastAvat kAri mA santu cedayaH” mAGaH । “mA kAri tAvat na kriyatAmevetyarTaH” malli॰ । tatparimARamasya tad + vatup “A sarvanAmnaH” pA॰ । A । 10 tatparimARaviSizwe tri॰ । “yAvAnarTa udapAne sarvataH saMplutodake । tAvAn sarvezu vedezu brAhmaRasya vijAnataH” gItA “jambudvIpo'yaM tAvatpramARavistArastAvatA kzIrodaGinA vezwitaH” BAga॰ 5 । 20 । 2 । kriyAviSezaRatve na॰ । “puro'sya yAvanna Buvi vyalIyata । girestaqitvAniva tAvaduccakEH” mAGaH । striyAM NIp “yAvatI saMBavedvfttistAvatI dAtumarhati” manuH । asya vatvantatvAt saMKyAvat kAryyaM tAvacCaH tAvatkaH tAvatikaH ।
m: तावत् mf(अती)n. (fr. 2. त, Pāṇ. v, 2, 39; vi, 3, 91) so great, so large, so much, so far, so long, so many (correlative of यावत्; rarely of य or यथोक्त, Nal. &c.), RV. &c. (यावता क्षणेन तावता, ‘after so long time, in that time’, as soon as, Rājat. v, 110)
just a little, Kir. ii, 48
(in alg.) an unknown quantity (also with यावत्)
तावत् ind. (correlative of यावत्) so much, so greatly, to such an extent, in such a number, so far, RV.; AV. &c. (तावत्-तावत्, ŚBr. i, 8, 1, 6)
so long, in that time, RV. x, 88, 19; ŚBr. i; Mn. &c.

meanwhile, in the mean time (the correlative यावत् being often connected with a neg., e.g. तावच् छोभते मूर्खो यावत् किं-चिन् न भाषते, ‘so long a fool shines as long as he says nothing’, Hit.; शोचयिष्याम्य् आत्मानं तावद् यावन् मे प्राप्तम् ब्राह्मण्यम्, ‘so long I will emaciate myself, as long as [i.e. until] I have obtained the state of a Brāhman’, R. i, 64, 19), ŚBr. xiv, 4, 2, 30; ChUp. vi, 14, 2; Mn.; MBh. &c. (also correlative of पुरा [R. i, 28, 21], of यावता न, of यावत् preceded by पुरा [MBh. xiii, 4556], or without any correlative [2727; Kathās.; Hit.])

at once, now, just, first (followed by अनन्तरम् [Hit.], अपरम् [Pañcat.], अपि [ib.], इदानीम् [Hit.], उत [Śak.], च [Daś.; Prab.], ततस् [Mn. iv, 174; Ragh. vii, 4 f.], तद्-अनु [Megh.], तु [Daś. vii; Vedāntas.], पश्चात् [R. ii], पुनर् [Pañcat.], वा; very often connected with an Impv., rarely [MBh. iv, 888; R. ii, 56, 13] with a Pot., often with the 1st person of pr. or fut. MBh. &c.; the Impv. is sometimes to be supplied [इतस् तावत्, ‘just come hither’; मा तावत्, ‘by no means, God forbid!’] Śak.; Mālav.; Vikr.; Prab.; sometimes अर्हसि with the inf. is used instead, R. i f.)
(with न or अ-) not yet, MBh. &c. (followed by यावत्, ‘while’, Kathās. xxvi, 23; तावन् न-अपि न, ‘not only not-but also not’, Kād.)
very well, all right, Hcar.
indeed, truly (e.g. दृढस् तावद् बन्धः, ‘the knot is tight I must admit’, Hit.; गता तावत्, ‘she is indeed gone’, Kathās. xviii, 241), R. &c.
already (opposed to ‘how much more’ or ‘how much less’), R. iv f.; Śak.
really (= एव, sometimes connected with this particle, e.g. विक्रयस् तावद् एव सः, ‘it is really a sale’), Mn. iii, 53; Hariv. 7110; R. &c.
तावत् [cf. Lat. tantus.]
a: तावत् — a. (Correlative of यावत् q. v.) 1 So much, that much, so many; ते तु यावंत एवाजौ तावांश्च ददृशे स तैः R. 12. 45; H. 4. 72; Ku. 2. 33. --2 So great, so large, of this extent; यावती संभवेद् वृत्तिस्तावतीं दातुमर्हसि Ms. 8. 155, 9. 249; Bg. 2. 46. --3 All (expressing totality); यावद्दत्तं तावद्भुक्तं G. M. --ind. 1 First (before doing anything else); आर्ये इतस्तावदागम्यतां Ś. 1; आह्लादयस्व तावच्चंद्रकरश्चंद्रकांतमिव V. 5. 11; Me. 13. --2 On one's part, in the meanwhile; सखे स्थिरप्रतिबंधो भव . अहं तावत् स्वामिनश्चित्तवृत्तिमनुवर्तिष्ये Ś. 2; R. 7. 32. --3 Just, now; गच्छ तावत्. --4 Indeed, (to emphasize an expression); त्वमेव तावत्प्रथमो राजद्रोही Mu. 1 ‘thou thyself’; त्वमेव तावत्परिचिंतय स्वयं Ku. 5. 67. --5 Truly, really (to express assent); दृढस्तावद्बंधः H. 1. --6 As for, with respect to; विग्रहस्तावदुपस्थितः H. 3; एवं कृते तव तावत्क्लेशं विना प्राणयात्रा भविष्यति Pt. 1. --7 Completely; तावत्प्रकीर्णाभिनवोपचारां R. 7. 4 ( तावत्प्रकीर्ण = साकल्येन प्रसारित Malli.). --8 Surprise (oh!, what a wonder). (For the senses of तावत् as a correlative of यावत्, see यावत्). --Comp. --कृत्वस् ind. so many times. --मात्रं just so much. --वर्ष a. so many years old.
